title: verify_registration.sh verifies wolfcrypt.ko, not crypto2dev — name is misleading
description: scripts/verify_registration.sh is named 'verify_registration' and the CLAUDE.md quality gate section says to run it. But it verifies that wolfkm (wolfcrypt.ko) algorithms appear in /proc/crypto — not anything about crypto2dev.ko's chardev registration. A maintainer reading the quality gate section would expect it to verify crypto2dev's chardev sysfs entry (/sys/class/misc/crypto2dev) or the algo list, not wolfcrypt.ko's kernel crypto API registration. What would make it clear: rename to verify_wolfkm_registration.sh or add a header comment explaining it is a prerequisite check (wolfcrypt.ko loaded and registered) that must pass before crypto2dev tests can be meaningful. Currently the CLAUDE.md quality gate instruction references this script without explaining what it actually checks.
